name: PayslipMaker.uk
description_en:
PayslipMaker.uk is a browser-based document generator, including a UK payslip tool with vendor-described PAYE, National Insurance, pension and student-loan calculations. It offers free proofread drafts and paid final PDFs without an individual account; it is not documented here as a payroll payment or HMRC filing service.

The site claims document data stays on the device and warns it cannot recover a file that was never downloaded. Those architectural and tax-accuracy claims were not independently tested, and a generated document does not itself verify the underlying employment or income.
description_zh:
PayslipMaker.uk 是浏览器文档生成器，包含供应商所称可计算 PAYE、National Insurance、养老金和学生贷款的英国工资单工具。它提供免费校阅草稿和付费最终 PDF，无需个人账户；本研究未确立它提供工资支付或 HMRC 申报。

网站称文档数据留在设备上，并提示未下载文件无法恢复。这些架构和税务准确性未经独立测试，生成的文档本身也不验证底层雇佣或收入。

core_features.name_zh: 英国工资单 PDF 准备
core_features.explanation_en: The tool describes employer/employee details, pay date/frequency, earnings, NI category and deduction settings feeding a PDF.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工具描述雇主员工资料、发薪日期频率、收入、NI 类别及扣款设置生成 PDF。

core_features.name_zh: 付费最终稿前免费草稿
core_features.explanation_en: Every generator offers a draft for proofreading; the final PDF uses pay-what-you-want pricing with a £1.99 floor.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每种生成器提供草稿校阅，最终 PDF 按自定金额付款，最低 1.99 英镑。

core_features.name_zh: 供应商描述的本地生成
core_features.explanation_en: The homepage claims no document-form upload and no account storage, which also limits file recovery.
core_features.explanation_zh: 首页称不上传文档表单、不以账户存储，因此文件恢复也受限。

pricing.summary_en: Free proofread draft; final PDF pay-what-you-want from £1.99, no individual subscription. Corporate credit packs are separate.
pricing.summary_zh: 校阅草稿免费，最终 PDF 自定金额，最低 1.99 英镑，个人无订阅；企业额度包另计。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Use authoritative payroll figures for a document
sections.title_zh: 用权威工资数据制作文档
sections.en: The payslip guide assembles employer and employee details, pay date and frequency, gross components, NI category and student-loan selections. It offers a YTD column and distinguishes a manually entered salary statement from the calculator-based payslip. A safe evaluation uses clearly fictional sample data and compares the preview with an independently approved payroll calculation. The page claims 2026/27 rates, but this research did not validate HMRC tables, cumulative logic, director rules or special tax cases. A professional PDF is not evidence that wages were earned, paid or reported.
sections.zh: 工资单指南组合雇主员工资料、日期频率、税前组成、NI 类别和学生贷款选项，提供年内累计列，并区分手动薪资说明和计算器工资单。评估可使用明确虚构样本，把预览与独立认可的工资计算比较。页面称使用 2026/27 费率，但本研究未验证 HMRC 表、累计逻辑、董事或特殊税务。专业 PDF 不证明收入已赚取、已支付或已申报。

sections.title_en: Local-generation claims have a recovery tradeoff
sections.title_zh: 本地生成说法伴随恢复取舍
sections.en: The homepage says form data is processed in the browser, not uploaded, and that the operator cannot recover an undownloaded document after the tab closes. It describes a network or offline test, but that test was not performed here. Individual no-account generation also means buyers should plan their own secure storage and correction workflow. Payment processing is described separately from document generation; do not infer the entire payment interaction is offline or that no external metadata exists. Production privacy, security and the handling of corporate bulk files remain unverified.
sections.zh: 首页称表单在浏览器处理、不上传，关闭标签页后运营方无法恢复未下载文档，并提出网络或离线测试，本研究未执行该测试。个人无需账户，也意味着买家需自行规划安全保存和纠错。付款处理与文档生成分开，不能推定付款全程离线或没有外部元数据。实际隐私、安全及企业批量文件处理仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Draft access is free; final documents are paid
sections.title_zh: 草稿免费，最终文档付费
sections.en: The pricing page sets a £1.99 minimum per final document, with the buyer choosing a higher amount if desired; there is no individual subscription or auto-renewal. Free calculators and free proofread drafts are distinct from unrestricted final PDFs. Corporate packs use pooled credits and a shared access code, with bulk Excel capability, so confirm team access, credit expiry and refund terms separately. A minimum payment is not a monthly payroll-service rate. No checkout, payment, final PDF, corporate code or upload was used.
sections.zh: 价格页规定每份最终文档最低 1.99 英镑，买家可自愿多付，个人无订阅或自动续费。免费计算器和校阅草稿不等于可无限取得最终 PDF。企业包使用共享额度和访问码，并有批量 Excel 能力，应另确认团队访问、额度到期和退款。最低付款不是月度工资服务费，未使用结账、付款、最终 PDF、企业码或上传。

sections.title_en: Check data before immediate digital delivery
sections.en: The refund policy covers duplicate/accidental charges, technical non-delivery and wrong output caused by the tool. It excludes correctly generated downloaded documents where the user entered wrong details, and asks for requests within 14 days; approved refunds are described as returning to the original method in 5–10 business days. These are vendor terms, not an independently assessed statement of consumer rights. PayslipMaker.uk may suit occasional document preparation from verified records; recurring payment, statutory submission, persistent employee management or official income verification need other evidence. Calculation limits, complete retention/deletion behavior, licensing and recovery remain unverified.
sections.zh: 退款政策覆盖重复误扣、技术未交付和工具导致的错误输出；排除输入有误但已正确生成下载的文档，要求 14 天内申请，并称获批后 5–10 个工作日原路退回。这是供应商条款，非独立消费者权利判断。用已核实记录偶尔制作文档可评估 PayslipMaker.uk；重复付款、法定申报、持续员工管理或正式收入验证需要其他证据。计算限制、完整保留删除行为、许可及恢复仍未核实。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No input, rate calculation, network/offline check, upload, payment or final download was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试输入、费率、网络离线、上传、付款或最终下载。

research_gaps.en: Statutory correctness, recipient acceptance, corporate access controls, storage/deletion and source-code license remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 法定正确性、接收方接受、企业权限、存储删除及源代码许可尚未核实。
